attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"The current President blocked the Keystone XL Pipeline, a project that would have brought Canadian and American oil to U.S. refineries and created thousands of jobs.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The current President's actions represent a job-killing combination of extremism and ineptitude and threaten to create a permanent energy shortage.", "claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to approve the Keystone XL Pipeline.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to streamline permitting for the development of other oil and natural gas pipelines.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Nuclear energy currently generates about 20 percent of U.S. electricity through 104 power plants.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"No new nuclear generating plants have been licensed and constructed for thirty years.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Call for timely processing of new reactor applications currently pending at the Nuclear Regulatory Commission.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The federal government's failure to address the storage and disposal of spent nuclear fuel has resulted in large bills for States and taxpayers.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The country needs a more proactive approach to managing spent nuclear fuel, including through developing advanced reprocessing technologies.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
